notes:
Refers to a nation's diplomatic and international relations work. Most commonly encountered in the compound {外務省|がいむしょう} (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) and {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん} (Minister of Foreign Affairs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外務省|がいむしょう}: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
- {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん}: Minister of Foreign Affairs
- {外務|がいむ}⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧: foreign affairs bureaucrat
- {外務|がいむ}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: foreign affairs staff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧: diplomacy — focuses on the practice of diplomatic relations rather than the administrative domain
- ⟦{内政|ないせい}→内政：24159_naisei⟧: domestic affairs — the counterpart to {外務|がいむ}
